name: Voxel-to-Image Slicing (Tiled EXR)
definition: A technique to render 3D voxel data in Cycles by converting raw volumetric data into a 2D tiled EXR image, where each tile represents a 2D slice of the volume along the Z-axis. This allows the renderer to access 3D data via 2D texture sampling.
summary: Voxel-to-Image Slicing converts 3D voxel data into a 2D tiled EXR image, flattening volumes into a grid of Z-axis slices to enable raster-based rendering via 2D texture sampling.
